overview_description.description: Paquik is a Dubai-based crowdshipping and peer-to-peer logistics platform that connects people who want to send parcels, documents, or gifts with verified travelers who have extra luggage space. Founded in 2022, the company aims to provide a faster, cheaper, and more flexible alternative to traditional courier services by leveraging a community-driven shipping model.
